WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    record_count,
    SUM(record_count) OVER () AS total_count,
    AVG(record_count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  record_count,
  CAST(record_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share_of_records,
  record_count - avg_count AS above_average
FROM stats
WHERE record_count > avg_count;
